description: Like get_affected_tests_by_branch, but correctly handles renamed and moved files. Uses --find-renames to detect file moves and --ignore-all-space to skip whitespace-only changes. Use instead of get_affected_tests_by_branch when the branch contains refactors or file moves.

project_root.description: Absolute path to the TypeScript project root (must contain tsconfig.json)

similarity_threshold.description: Minimum similarity % to consider a file move a rename (default: 90)

name: get_rename_aware_diff
